# dte-sdk

> TypeScript SDK for Chilean electronic tax documents (DTE): build, stamp (TED), sign (XMLDSig) and envelope documents for the SII and talk to the SII web services (upload, status, acceptance/claims), with an English domain model, bilingual EN/ES JSDoc and RUT handling delegated to rut.ts.

dte-sdk covers document types 33, 34, 39, 41, 43, 46, 52, 56 and 61. `createDocument` validates and normalizes input (RUTs via rut.ts, text sanitized, schema lengths enforced, totals computed with per-line rounding, VAT-included prices via `MntBruto`, withholding for purchase invoices, receipt defaults). `toSiiDocument`/`fromSiiDocument` map the English model (`totalAmount`, `issuer.businessName`) to the official SII tags (`MntTotal`, `RznSoc`) in schema order. `stampDocument` builds the exact `<DD>` string and signs it with the CAF private key (SHA1withRSA over ISO-8859-1 bytes). `signDocument` applies the enveloped XMLDSig signature (C14N 1.0, RSA-SHA1) the SII validates. `createEnvelope`/`signEnvelope` produce `EnvioDTE`/`EnvioBOLETA`. Certificates load from PKCS#12 or PEM; CAF files are parsed and checked for range and the 6-month expiry of invoice/note CAFs. Status codes from the SII web services are classified (`accepted`, `pending`, `rejected`, `queryError`). Errors are `DteError` with stable codes and no personal data in messages. All clock-dependent functions accept `{ now }`.

The SII web services client is `createSiiClient({ environment, certificate, companyRut })` plus free functions: `uploadEnvelope`/`uploadBook`/`uploadFolioConsumption` (DTEUpload multipart in ISO-8859-1, or the receipts REST API in production; the XML must open with a declaration naming ISO-8859-1; duplicates return the original TrackID), `queryUploadStatus`/`waitForUploadStatus`/`queryDocumentStatus`/`folioReceived`, and the acceptance/claim registry `registerClaim`/`listClaimEvents`/`queryTransferable`/`queryReceptionDate`/`receiverStatus`. Tokens are obtained and renewed automatically per environment, channel and certificate. Transport is injectable (`fetch` by default, `createNodeHttpsTransport` with TLS verification on; `tls.ca` adds to Node's bundled roots), retries use exponential backoff and never re-send an upload or a claim after an SII answer (not even a partial one), and `capture`/`archive` ports record redacted HTTP exchanges and the bytes of every upload.

The SII books are `createPurchaseSalesBook` (IECV, `LibroCompraVenta`), `createGuideBook` (`LibroGuia`) and `createFolioConsumption` (RCOF, `ConsumoFolios`), each with `build*Xml`, `sign*`, `verify*Signature` and `toSii*`. All submission kinds of the schemas are covered, and the SDK computes the summaries from the lines; `summaryOnlyTotals` and `previousTotals` carry what cannot be derived. An explicit line total that differs from the SII formula is kept and reported in `totalMismatches`, and `strictTotals: true` throws `BOOK_TOTAL_MISMATCH` instead. `bookEntryFromDocument`, `guideEntryFromDocument` and `folioConsumptionEntryFromDocument` derive the lines from issued documents. The signed XML goes to `uploadBook` or `uploadFolioConsumption`. The RCV replaced the IECV in production from period 2017-08, the guide book is sent only on SII request, and the report is used in the receipts certification; the SII probably no longer requires it in production.

The SII portal is `createPortalClient({ environment, certificate, companyRut })` plus free functions, on Node ≥ 20 (client certificate over `https`; TLS 1.2, server verified). The certificate must be enabled as a login method at sii.cl, or the login throws `SII_PORTAL_CERT_NOT_ENABLED`. Session: `openPortalSession`, `closePortalSession`, or on demand; `sessionCache` and `lock` are ports for several replicas. Company data: `fetchCompanyResolution` (per environment), `fetchTaxpayerData`, `fetchIssuerProfile`, `queryCertificationSets`. Folios: `listStampableTypes`, `queryFolioQuota` (`MAX_AUTOR`, `FOLIOS_DISP`; stamps nothing), `requestCaf`, `listFolioRanges`, `annulFolios` (explicit scope required; irreversible; counts against the quota for six months), `listReobtainableRanges`, `reobtainCaf`. Composite flows return refusals as data: `requestCafExact`, `requestCafInBatches`, `reobtainFolios`. Refusals are `SII_PORTAL_REJECTED` with `details.rejection` and `portalRejectionMessage`. `createFolioRegistry`, `createMemoryFolioRegistry` and `createDirectoryFolioRegistry` track folios locally. The CAF XML holds a private key: treat it as a secret.

- [Package on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dte-sdk)
- [rut.ts](https://github.com/arrowsw/rut.ts): the RUT library dte-sdk depends on
